## Functions

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `fake` | fake(kind=, locale=) random realistic value; see fake kinds |
| `uuid` | uuid() random UUID v4 |
| `ulid` | ulid() ULID |
| `now` | now(format=, offset=) current time; offset like -1d, +2h, 30m |
| `random_int` | random_int(min=, max=) inclusive |
| `random_float` | random_float(min=, max=, precision=) |
| `pick` | pick(from=[...]) one random item |
| `weighted` | weighted(items=[...], weights=[...]) |
| `seq` | seq(name=) 1, 2, 3... per name until state reset |
| `repeat` | repeat(n=) array of n items for loops |
| `jsonpath` | jsonpath(value=, path=) first match or null |
| `hmac_sha256` | hmac_sha256(key=, data=) hex digest |
| `jwt` | jwt(claims=, secret=) HS256 token |
| `lorem` | lorem(words=) filler text |
| `file` | file(path=) workspace-relative file contents |
| `dataset_rows` | dataset_rows(data=data.orders, filter="status=open&total_gte=5", sort="total", order="desc", page=1, limit=10) filtered, sorted, paged rows of a Dataset |
| `dataset_count` | dataset_count(data=data.orders, filter="status=open") number of rows matching a filter |

## Callback context

Inside a Callback (`url`, `headers`, `body`) the usual context is joined by `response` (`status`, `headers`, `body`, `json` of the Response that was sent) and, for `url` and `headers`, `callback` (`id`, `method` and `body`, the rendered body, so `hmac_sha256(key=vars.secret, data=callback.body)` signs what is sent). See the Callbacks guide.
